Before raising a help request, make sure you have read the [documentation](https://mindrustuk.github.io/Heatmiser-for-home-assistant/).

If your request is to do with how to do something in Home Assistant that uses this integration, you might find it better to use the Home Assistant community forum. You can also look at the dedicated [thread](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/heatmiser-neo-hub-support-ugly-and-work-in-progress) for this integration.
